mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_pricing (model, input_price_per_1k, output_price_per_1k, remark, update_time) VALUES (#{model}, #{inputPricePer1k}, #{outputPricePer1k}, #{remark}, #{updateTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE input_price_per_1k = VALUES(input_price_per_1k), output_price_per_1k = VALUES(output_price_per_1k), remark = VALUES(remark), update_time = VALUES(update_time)

INSERT INTO model_pricing (model, input_price_per_1k, output_price_per_1k, remark, update_time) VALUES (#{model}, #{inputPricePer1k}, #{outputPricePer1k}, #{remark}, #{updateTime}) ON CONFLICT (model) DO UPDATE SET input_price_per_1k = EXCLUDED.input_price_per_1k, output_price_per_1k = EXCLUDED.output_price_per_1k, remark = EXCLUDED.remark, update_time = EXCLUDED.update_time
mapper.sql: id, model, input_price_per_1k, output_price_per_1k, remark, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM model_pricing ORDER BY model ASC
